"""Publish the closed original bench.sh phase-OFF control and method policy."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import shutil
import statistics

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'
WF = G / '.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-phase-cache-pair'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_pair_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(hashes(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


def archive(path, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-stock-pair-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
        commands=[], evidence={}, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = load(B / 'main-phase-cache-serial-gate-build-root-v6/record.json')['environment']

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED PHASE PAIR PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=4 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f'
        assert not run('status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        lp = B / 'main-phase-cache-stock-on-launch-root-v1/record.json'
        off_path = B / 'main-phase-cache-stock-off-launch-root-v1/record.json'
        off = load(off_path)
        assert off['passed'] and off['complete'] and not off['active']
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in off['commands'])
        launch = load(lp)
        assert launch['passed'] and launch['complete'] and not launch['active']
        assert launch['phase_cache'] == 1 and launch['copy_engine'] == 0 and launch['stock_long_comparison_eligible']
        off_q, on_q = load(off['main_config']['path']), load(launch['main_config']['path'])
        assert off_q['binary_sha256'] == on_q['binary_sha256']
        assert off_q['engine_argv'] == on_q['engine_argv']
        off_env = dict(off_q['engine_environment']); off_env['STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE'] = '1'
        assert off_env == on_q['engine_environment']
        assert not launch['quality_evaluated'] and not launch['adopted']
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in launch['commands'])
        for item in (launch['supervisor_result'], launch['upstream_result'], launch['source_closure'], launch['main_config']):
            assert m.sha(item['path']) == item['sha256']
        sp = Path(launch['supervisor_result']['path'])
        supervisor = load(sp)
        assert supervisor['passed'] and supervisor['complete'] and not supervisor['active']
        assert all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in supervisor['commands'])
        assert supervisor['normal_quit']['normal_quit'] and not supervisor['normal_quit']['fallback_signals']
        assert all(not v['faults'] for k, v in supervisor.items() if k.startswith('kernel-'))
        samples = launch['result_assessment']['samples']
        assert len(samples) == 3
        assert all(s['prompt_tokens'] == s['read_tokens'] == 32049 and s['reused_tokens'] == 0 and s['generated_tokens'] == 24 for s in samples)
        source = load(launch['source_closure']['path'])
        assert all(m.sha(path) == digest for path, digest in source['source_pins'].items())
        F.mkdir()
        originals = {str(path): m.sha(path) for path in (off_path, lp, sp, Path(launch['upstream_result']['path']))}
        dump(F / 'receipts/off-launch.json', off)
        dump(F / 'receipts/on-launch.json', launch)
        dump(F / 'receipts/supervisor.json', supervisor)
        for name in ('main-config.json', 'server-quiet.json', 'closed-source-config-review.json'):
            archive(lp.parent / name, F / 'configuration' / (name + '.json'))
        result = Path(launch['upstream_result']['path'])
        target = F / 'upstream/results.json'
        target.parent.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(result, target)
        assert m.sha(target) == m.sha(result) and not load(target)['results']['failures']
        archive(result.parent / 'README.md', F / 'upstream/README.md.json')
        for name in ('main-phase-cache-stock-bench-launch-v1.py', 'main-phase-cache-stock-bench-launch-v2.py', 'main-phase-cache-stock-pair-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        P = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-source-v3'
        for path in sorted(P.glob('*.py.txt')):
            archive(path, F / 'supervisor-source' / (path.name + '.json'))
        engine = sp.parent / 'engine.log'
        rows = engine.read_text().splitlines()
        retained = [row for row in rows if re.search(r'INFO|READY|phase-cache|native|cache|pool|kv|GPU|WARNING|ERROR|FATAL|SYCL', row, re.I)]
        dump(F / 'engine-evidence.json', dict(path=str(engine), bytes=engine.stat().st_size,
            sha256=m.sha(engine), retained_lines=retained, extraction='Configuration, runtime path and fault summaries; successful repetitions retired'))
        stdout = sp.parent / 'bench.stdout'
        archive(stdout, F / 'official-console.json')
        reports = ['research-phase-refill-queue-bandwidth-gap-round380-v1.txt',
            'research-head-alias-12288-admission-round381-v1.txt',
            'implementation-head-alias-phase-12k-candidate-v1.txt',
            'research-production-fixed-history-capture-seam-round382-v1.txt',
            'research-decode-nt1-activation-quant-reuse-round383-v1.txt',
            'research-hyperconnection-gated-plane-lifetime-round384-v1.txt',
            'research-compact-moe-dm-streaming-round385-v1.txt']
        report_pins = []
        for name in reports:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            report_pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-phase-off-control/report-registry-v189.json'
        assert load(previous)['research_completed'] == 922
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v190.json', dict(research_completed=929,
            prior=dict(path=str(previous), git_revision='499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f', sha256=m.sha(previous)),
            new_reports=report_pins, main_only_test_execution=True))
        def stats(key):
            values = [s[key] for s in samples]
            return dict(samples=values, median=statistics.median(values), minimum=min(values), maximum=max(values))
        off_samples = off['result_assessment']['samples']
        def arm_stats(rows, key):
            values = [s[key] for s in rows]
            return dict(samples=values, median=statistics.median(values), minimum=min(values), maximum=max(values))
        prefill = [arm_stats(rows, 'prompt_tps') for rows in (off_samples, samples)]
        decode = [arm_stats(rows, 'decode_tps') for rows in (off_samples, samples)]
        pref_delta = (prefill[1]['median'] / prefill[0]['median'] - 1) * 100
        dec_delta = (decode[1]['median'] / decode[0]['median'] - 1) * 100
        N = G / '.worktree/feat-phase-prefill-12k-20261013'
        changes = run('candidate-changed', ['git', '-C', str(N), 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        assert len(changes) == 10 and not run('candidate-new', ['git', '-C', str(N), 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'])
        snapshots = []
        import difflib
        for name in changes:
            base, candidate = W/name, N/name
            before, after = base.read_text(), candidate.read_text()
            snapshots.append(dict(path=name, base_sha256=m.sha(base), source_sha256=m.sha(candidate),
                unified_diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True), after.splitlines(keepends=True),
                    fromfile='a/'+name, tofile='b/'+name))))
        dump(F/'candidate-source-unqualified/head-alias-12k.json', dict(worktree=str(N),
            base_revision='499f226a0f3b46aa1bdcd0314fd0f81558799f6f', patches=snapshots,
            source_only=True, built=False, tested=False, runtime_qualified=False, quality_qualified=False,
            physical_fit_qualified=False, owner='Main', byte_budget=2<<20,
            consumer='Main serialized sourceLLVM builds/lints/host/ASan/runtime and numerical qualification',
            next_review='After candidate builds and runtime qualification'))
        summary = dict(main_reviewed=True, benchmark_method='Unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3',
            source_revision=launch['source_revision'], off_source_revision=off['source_revision'],
            source_difference='Documentation/report commit only; compiled source, binary and complete argv match',
            binary_sha256=on_q['binary_sha256'], upstream_revision=launch['upstream_revision'],
            copy_engine=0, order=[0,1], samples_by_phase_cache=[off_samples,samples],
            prefill_by_phase_cache=prefill, decode_by_phase_cache=decode,
            prefill_median_change_percent=pref_delta, decode_median_change_percent=dec_delta,
            actual_prompt_tokens=32049, actual_generated_tokens=24,
            stock_long_comparison_eligible=True, strict32768_performance_eligible=False,
            all_official_requests_succeeded=True, no_fresh_gpu_faults=True,
            identities_unchanged=True, normal_quit=True, optimization_adopted=False,
            quality_evaluated=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False, research_registry_count=929,
            decision='Keep default OFF. ON prefill median is lower; decode ranges overlap and do not resolve its effect. Repeat matched arms before decode adoption.',
            limitations=['One sequential OFF then ON campaign, with stock nonce/history variation.',
                'ON values trend upward;24-token decode continuations vary. Medians alone do not identify a causal effect.',
                'Native COPY remains0; no head lease, scratch alias,12K or dtype candidate executed.'],
            main_errata=['R381 mistakenly describes current Main benchmark as OFF; assigned and actual active run was ON. It did not inspect the run.',
                'R382 asks no EOS/truncation override but proposes explicit score_all; any forced history must record its diagnostic EOS override and exact consumed IDs.',
                'R383 corroborates earlierR371 activation reuse; the negative result supports no redundant activation-cache implementation.',
                'Gated overlay and streamedDm are source hypotheses. Dm may change FP32 accumulation order; shared maximum may clip savings.'],
            next_step='Main builds/reviews source-only head/alias12K after closure; repeat matched official decode arms and implement actual production fixed-history diagnostics before adoption')
        dump(F/'summary.json',summary)
        table='\n'.join(f'| {i} | {j+1} | {row["prompt_tokens"]} | {row["generated_tokens"]} | {row["prompt_tps"]:.1f} | {row["decode_tps"]:.1f} |'
            for i,arm in enumerate((off_samples,samples)) for j,row in enumerate(arm))
        ja=f"""<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# 上流 bench.sh による phase cache 比較

Arc B570 / Ryzen 5600X、free/source-built DPC++ 7.1.1、native IQ3_S で、
変更していない上流 v0.1.43 の bench.sh --long --runs 3 を使いました。
同じ binary、argv、model、client で OFF の後に ON を測定しました。
間の source commit は手順とレポートだけです。COPY 0、chunk 8192/group 16、
workers 5/tasks 18、no borrow/MTP/reuse、int8 KV resident 32768/context 262144。
trace と validation は無効で、違う設定は STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE だけです。

| Phase cache | Run | 実入力/read | 出力 | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
{table}

再利用は全件 0、出力は 24 でした。prefill 中央値は OFF {prefill[0]['median']:.1f}、
ON {prefill[1]['median']:.1f} tok/s（{pref_delta:+.2f}%）。decode 中央値は
OFF {decode[0]['median']:.1f}、ON {decode[1]['median']:.1f}（{dec_delta:+.2f}%）ですが、
範囲 {decode[0]['minimum']:.1f}–{decode[0]['maximum']:.1f} と
{decode[1]['minimum']:.1f}–{decode[1]['maximum']:.1f} は重なります。
ON の値は試行順に上がり、24 出力のばらつきもあるため、decode 改善の
確定や採用はしません。既定 OFF を維持し、decode の判断には対応する
OFF/ON の反復を増やします。prefill と decode を同じ判定にしません。

両条件は全リクエスト成功、正常 QUIT、exit 0、所有 process の終了、
前後の source/binary/model/provider 照合を通りました。新しい GPU fault は
なく、reset、サービス変更、再試行は行っていません。標準の約 32K ケース
であり、全物理 256K、持続 decode、品質を認定する結果ではありません。
上流 ON の results.json は元の bytes をそのまま保存し、OFF は前のレポートに
残しています。短い会話と agent は補助結果です。

並行調査 7 件を registry v190 に追加しました。入力量子化は既に expert 間で
共有されており、重複削減案は採りません。head lease、FP32 scratch aliases、
明示 12K の候補は別 worktree の source 差分だけを保存しています。ビルド、
実行、fit、数値品質は未認定です。Main が測定終了後に検証します。
実モデルの fixed-history logits producer と後続の gated overlay / Dm streaming
も別途検証が必要です。生成文の完全一致は品質の一般条件にしません。
成功した重複ログを、証拠と hash を確認した削除 manifest に従って削除します。
"""
        en=f"""<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Upstream bench.sh phase cache comparison

Unchanged upstream v0.1.43 bench.sh --long --runs3 ran OFF then ON on Arc B570 /
Ryzen5600X, free/source-built DPC++7.1.1, native IQ3_S. Binary/argv/model/client
match; the intervening source commit changed method documentation and reports.
COPY0, chunk8192/group16, workers5/tasks18, no borrow/MTP/reuse, int8 KV
resident32768/context262144. Tracing/validation were disabled. The only changed
setting is STRATA_PHASE_DECODE_CACHE.

| Phase cache | Run | Actual input/read | Output | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
{table}

Every row read32049 tokens, reused0 and generated24. Prefill medians are
{prefill[0]['median']:.1f} and {prefill[1]['median']:.1f} tok/s ({pref_delta:+.2f}%).
Decode medians are {decode[0]['median']:.1f} and {decode[1]['median']:.1f} ({dec_delta:+.2f}%),
but ranges {decode[0]['minimum']:.1f}–{decode[0]['maximum']:.1f} and
{decode[1]['minimum']:.1f}–{decode[1]['maximum']:.1f} overlap. ON values rise in
run order, and24-output decode continuations vary. No decode benefit or adoption
is established; retain default OFF and repeat matched arms before that decision.
Assess prefill and decode independently.

Both campaigns passed every request, original QUIT, exit0, owned-process closure
and before/after source/binary/model/provider checks with no fresh GPU fault,
reset, service change or retry. This stock approx32K case does not qualify full
physical256K, sustained decode or quality. ON upstream results.json is retained
byte-for-byte; OFF is in the preceding report. Chat/agent are supporting results.

Registry v190 adds7 research reports. Input activation quantization is already
shared across experts; no redundant cache is proposed. A separate source-only
head-lease/FP32 scratch-alias/explicit12K candidate is archived as deltas; build,
runtime, fit and numerical quality are unqualified. Main owns checks after this
measurement. Production fixed-history logits capture and later gated overlay /
Dm streaming also need qualification. Exact prose identity is not a universal
quality gate. Closed duplicates retire under the verified deletion manifest.
"""
        (F/'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F/'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
        raw_files = list(sp.parent.glob('*.stdout')) + list(sp.parent.glob('*.stderr')) + [engine]
        raw_files += list((lp.parent/'commands').glob('*.stdout')) + list((lp.parent/'commands').glob('*.stderr'))
        deletions = []
        for raw in sorted(set(raw_files)):
            if not raw.exists():continue
            if raw.name.startswith('kernel-') and raw.suffix == '.stdout' and raw.name != 'kernel-cursor.stdout':
                j=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
                assert not supervisor[raw.stem]['faults']
            if raw.parent == lp.parent/'commands':
                assert raw.read_text() == launch['evidence'].get(raw.stem,dict(stdout=launch.get('stdout',''),stderr=launch.get('stderr','')))[raw.suffix[1:]]
            deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw),bytes=raw.stat().st_size,sha256=m.sha(raw),
                replacement='receipts/supervisor.json, official-console.json, engine-evidence.json and unchanged upstream/results.json',
                reason='Closed successful duplicate/API or repeated journal history; useful evidence preserved'))
        retention=dict(owner='Main',deletions=deletions,deleted=False,original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,
            active_runs_touched=False,free_space_claim=False,byte_budget=4<<20,
            consumer='Matched repeated phase comparison and future source/numerical qualification',
            next_review='After matched phase comparison or superseding diagnostics')
        dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',retention)
        files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
        files += []
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('report-policy-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files])
        run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(path)==sha for path,sha in originals.items())
        assert all(m.sha(row['path'])==row['sha256'] for row in deletions)
        for row in deletions:Path(row['path']).unlink()
        retention.update(deleted=True,removed_file_count=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions))
        dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',retention)
        run('stage',['git','add','--',str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit',['git','commit','-m','docs(bench): record phase cache OFF ON measurements and next source candidates'])
        r['commit']=run('committed-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
        run('push',['git','push','-u','origin','feat/phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True,complete=True,research_registry_count=929,summary=summary,
            removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error']=repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','commit','research_registry_count','removed_files')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
